thread.title: What To Watch For When These Five Tech Giants Report Quarterly Earnings

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: What To Watch For When These Five Tech Giants Report Quarterly Earnings

organizations.name: watch for when these five tech giants

text:
Five big technology companies, starting with Facebook ( FB ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ), are set to report quarterly results at the end of this month — events that often cause big movement in stocks.
X Facebook and Microsoft will report quarterly earnings on Jan. 31, while Apple ( AAPL ), Alibaba ( BABA ) and Google-owner Alphabet ( GOOGL ) report Feb. 1.
All five stocks are trading close to their record highs. Any of them posting results short of expectations or presenting a disappointing outlook could trigger a sudden decline in the stock. Strong results could lead to positive breakouts.
When Facebook reports after the close Jan. 31, among things analysts will focus on will be comments around capital allocation and return on invested capital. Facebook has guided capital expenditures to roughly double, hitting somewhere around $14 billion in 2018. User growth and commentary around the performance of Facebook's Instagram business will also be areas of interest.
Facebook this week received positive reports from two Wall Street analysts on Monday, with one calling the social networking giant its " top pick for 2018 ."
Facebook shares inched down 3 cents to close at 187.84 on the stock market today . Shares hit a record high of 188.90 on Monday.
At Microsoft, which also reports after the close, analysts will want updates on the impact of new tax legislation, including repatriation of offshore cash. The tax bill provides a reduced tax rate that could encourage Microsoft to redeploy offshore cash for shareholder benefit. Analysts also will seek an update on the performance of Microsoft's cloud computing operation, which has been gaining on market leader Amazon.
Microsoft shares lost 0.5% to 87.82. It hit a record high of 88.73 on Tuesday.
Apple will report after the market close on Feb. 1, as will Alphabet. Alibaba reports before the open that day.
Analysts say Apple is positioned to deliver results ahead of expectations. It will likely provide an update on its tax rate and repatriation plans post tax reform. As always, a focus will be on the performance of Apple iPhone products, including product demand, supply constraints and the average selling price. The consensus on iPhone shipments is 79 million. Apple may deliver a bigger-than-expected stock buyback , thanks to overseas cash brought back into the U.S., which could soothe investor angst over how sales of the iPhone X are doing.
Apple shares eased by 4 cents to 174.29. Shares hit a record high of 177.20 on Dec. 18.
